s287.v:
(1)
prabho kṛṣṇa-caitanya gauraṅga viśvambhara śrī-śacī-nandana prema-sindho
hare kṛṣṇa gopala govinda nandatmaja goṣṭha-gopī-jana-praṇa-bandho

s287.t: 1) O Lord Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, Gauraṅga, Viśvambhara, Śri Śaci-nandana, O ocean of ecstatic love, O Hari, Kṛṣṇa, Gopāla, Govinda, O son of Nanda, O life-friend of the vraja-gopis, glory to You!

s288.v:
(1)
payaya kṛpaya prema-sudhaṁ maṁ karaya nija-sevaṁ bahudha mam

s288.t: 1) Please mercifully make me drink the nectar of ecstatic love. Please make me serve You in many ways.

s288.v:
(2)
śrī-govinda madana-gopala gopīnatha
śrī-kṛṣṇa hare vraja-jana-gīta-līla-gatha

s288.t: 2) O Śri Govinda, O Lord more handsome than Kāmadeva, O master of the gopis, O Śri Kṛṣṇa, O Hari, O Lord whose pastimes the people of Vraja glorify in song!
3) Please allow me to see the glory of Your nectar sweet sidelong glance. Please reveal to me Your qualities, forms, and pastimes.

s288.v:
(4)
śrī-vṛndavana-kuñja-vihariṇi radhe hari-dayite
naya nija-caraṇa-saroja-talaṁ mam urarī-kuru lalite

s288.t: 4) O Rādhā, O beloved, of Lord Hari, O Goddess who enjoy pastimes in the forest groves of Vṛndāvana, please bring me to Your lotus feet. O beautiful one, please accept me.

s289.t: 1) O daughter of King Vṛṣabhanu, O lotus-eyed Goddess who are the great treasure of my eyes, I bow down before You.
2) O Goddess whose glistening-mirror toenails defeat many millions of nectar moons! O Goddess who charm the cakora bird of Lord Kṛṣṇa's heart!
3) O Goddess whose graceful beauty is praised by Lakṣmi-devi! O Goddess whom Lalitā and the other gopis decorate with yāvaka!
4) O goddess who serves Lord Kṛṣṇa! O Goddess whose heart is decorated with thoughts of Lord Kṛṣṇa! O Goddess learned in the art of sweet dancing in the rāsa pastimes!

s290.t: 1) Here, to this beautiful forest grove graceful with kurubaka flowers and beautiful guñjā berries, . . .
2) . . . please bring the saintly girl whose deep virtues have no equal in the three worlds.
3) Please take My words seriously. Please lead Me across the great ocean of amorous desires.

s290.v:
(4)
bhavatīṁ gatim avalambe
mad-ucitam iha kuru vigata-vilambe

s290.t: 4) I take shelter of You. Please do what I ask without delay."

s290.v:
(5)
iti gadita madhu-ripuṇa
tvaritam agad iyam ati-nipuṇa

s290.t: 5) Hearing Lord Kṛṣṇa's words, the very intelligent gopi at once departed.

s290.v:
(6)
rahasi sarasi caṭu radham
samabodhayad agha-hara-puru-badham

s290.t: 6) In a secluded place by a lake, that gopi told Rādhā of Lord Kṛṣṇa's great anguish.

s290.v:
(7)
hṛdi sakhi vasasi murareḥ
jvalayasi tad api kim akṛta-vicare

s290.t: 7) She said to Rādhā, O friend, You reside always in Kṛṣṇa's heart. O inconsiderate one, why do You set Him on fire in this way?

s290.v:
(8)
adhuna diśi ca valantī
śiśiraya tad amita-ruci-vibhavantī

s290.t: 8) Please go to Him now. Show Him limitless love and splendor and bliss. Cool the fires that burn in Him.

s290.v:
(9)
hari-vallabha-giram amalam
śravasi racaya sumanasam iva mṛdulam

s290.t: 9) Please make Kṛṣṇa's loving words a delicate sumanaḥ flower resting on Your ear."

s291.v:
(refrain)
sundari kalaya sapadi nija-caritam
tvam atanu-karmaṇa-viduṣi rasikam amum akarṣasi guṇa-kalitam

s291.t: 1) O beautiful one, please reveal Your true nature at once. O magician of amorous pastimes. Cast a spell and attract He who is full of virtues.

s291.v:
(2)
nija-mandiram anupada-lasad-indiram api parihaya vilasī
abhavad apasta-samasta-kalaṁ giri-kandara-taṭa-vana-vasī

s291.t: 2) Leaving His own palace, where glorious Goddess Lakṣmī enjoys pastimes, He now enjoys pastimes on the hills, in the caves, in the valleys, in the forests, and on the banks of the rivers and lakes.

s291.v:
(3)
bhavad-anuraga-nṛpo kṛta ha kim akaraṇa-vairam aparam
praharati manasija-dhanvy amuna prahito yad amuṁ kativaram

s291.t: 3) He rules over the kingdom of love for You. Why would He hate You for no reason? How many times does Kāmadeva, gripping his bow, attack Him with arrows?

s291.v:
(4)
jīvayituṁ yadi kantam anaṅga-guṇalayam icchasi kante
abhisara samprati bhamini hari-vallabha-bhuvi bhante

s291.t: 4) O beautiful one, O passionate one, O abode of love for Lord Hari, O splendid one, if You wish to save His life, please go at once to Your beloved, who is the home of all virtues a passionate lover can posses."

s292.v:
(1)
ma tuda muñca paṭantam iti sphuṭa-kuṭila-mukhaṁ smita-miśram
ṣaḍavam iva prīti-śrita-bhuja-bala-raśir agharir akṛṣṭam

s292.t: 1) With half a smile in Her crooked mouth, Rādhā says, Don't hit Me! Let go of the edge of My clothing!" With His powerful arms Kṛṣṇa pulls Her to Him.

s292.v:
(refrain)
sakhi he paśya nayana-sukha-saram
rasika-mukuṭa-tanu-yugalam adhi śrita-bahu-vidha-madana-vikaram

s292.t: 2) O friend, look at the two crowns of they who know how to taste nectar, two crowns that enjoy many different kinds of amorous pastimes, two crowns that give the best happiness the eyes can enjoy.

s292.v:
(3)
caṭulita-vikaṭa-cilli-dhanur-arpita-śaṇita-śoṇa-kaṭakṣa
tarjati dayitam imaṁ tad api prati parirambhana-rasa-dakṣa

s292.t: 3) The fearsome, always bending archer's bows of Her restless eyebrows again and again shooting sharp reddened arrows from the corners of Her eyes, Rādhā, who is expert at tasting the nectar of embraces, again and again rebukes Her beloved.

s292.v:
(4)
mukham ati-putam idaṁ yuvati-vraja-rasana-rasitam akhaṇḍam
sparśaya ma dayitety abhidhaya punar dhayati priya-gaṇḍam

s292.t: 4) Beloved, please don't touch Me with Your lips, lips that are supremely pure, lips again and again tasted by the girls of Vraja." As She speaks these words, Rādhā kisses Kṛṣṇa's cheeks.

s292.v:
(5)
virama satītvam ajani mama khaṇḍitam iti hitam api tava siddham
iti sa sa-ruṣeva radair nija-vallabham adhare racayati viddham

s292.t: 5) Plkease stop! You have broken My chastity. You have got what You wanted." Speaking these words, Rādhā angrily bit Her beloved Kṛṣṇa's lip.

s293.t: 1) Her delicate limbs sweetly embarced by Kṛṣṇa's arms, with glistening and playful eyes, Rādhā gazes at the splendid moon of Kṛṣṇa's face.
2) Resting on the bed of amorous pastimes, graceful and playful Rādhā gently smiled.
3) Many times She tightly embraced Her beloved. Many times He placed the sharp elephant-goads of His fingernails on Her waterpot breasts.
4) Her peacefulness and shyness broken by Kāmadeva's arrows, She became plunged in the nectar ocean of love.
5) She passionately drank the nectar of Her beloved's lips. Her body was flooded with perspiration.
6) Her bracelets and other ornaments sweetly tinkled. Her body's fragrance was like a host of flowers that attracts swarms of bumblebees.
7) Her body was like a newly-blossomed lotus flower anointed with musk. Dishevelled hair surrounded Her perspiring face.
8) In this way Her sweetness bore its fruit. Rādhā is most expert at enjoying nectar pastimes with Her charming lover.

s294.t: 1) O Kṛṣṇa, O son of Nanda, O Lord whose dark face is graceful with a gentle smile, glory to You!
2) O Lord splendid with a Kaustubha jewel and with bracelets, armlets, and many tinkling ornaments!

3) O Kṛṣṇa, O Lord whose feet rebuke the lotus flowers! O Lord who walks home on the winding path in the forest! O Lord whose glistening jewel-mirror toenails defeat millions of moons and punish the great darkness!

4) O Kṛṣṇa, O Lord whose hands and feet bear graceful auspicious marks! O Lord who walks like a graceful intoxicated elephant! O Lord the end of whose great flower garland is kissed by Your sweetly tinkling anklets!

5) O Kṛṣṇa, O Lord who wears glistening golden garments, O Lord whose jewel belt dances with always-sweet gracefulness, O Lord whose abdomen has three graceful folds of skin by the shore Your navel-lake!

s294.v:
(6)
kṛṣṇa kunda-dama-capala bandhura-tunda-śobhita-tarala
vakṣasi bhṛgu-pada-lakṣaṇa-salakṣaṇa indiraṅka-rucira

s294.t: 6) O Kṛṣṇa decorated with a splendid jasmine garland, O Lord whose abdomen is splendid and graceful, O Lord whose chest bears Bhṛgu Muni's footprint and Goddess Lakṣmi's mark!
7) O Kṛṣṇa whose arms are broad, O Lord whose graceful pastimes are eternally new and fresh, O lotus-eyed hero who pushes Śri Rādhā into an ocean of bliss!

8) O Kṛṣṇa, O Lord who wears graceful earrings, O Lord whose hair rebukes the splendid blue lotus flowers, O Lord whose forehead is splendid with tilaka, O Lord whose nose and teeth are splendid and graceful!

9) O Kṛṣṇa, O Lord who gracefully plays the flute, O Lord who wears a splendid peacock-feather crown, O Lord whose splendor defeats a host of blue lotus flowers, O Lord whose ever-new handsomeness defeats the sapphires!
10) O Kṛṣṇa, O Lord expert and graceful in the rāsa dance, O Lord who enjoys sweet pastimes eternally, O Lord whose graceful teeth and garments bear the marks of the gopis' black mascara!

s295.v:
(1)
madhura gokulanandana chavila-vṛndavana-candra
muralīdhara madhusudana madhava gopīnatha mukunda
keli-kala-nidhi-kuñja-viharin giridhara ananda-kanda
radhe kṛṣṇa radhe

s295.t: 1) O Rādhā! O Kṛṣṇa! O Rādhā! O chamring Lord! O bliss of Gokula! O splendid moon shining in Vṛndāvana forest! O flutist! O killer of Madhu! O husband of Goddess Lakṣmi! O master of the gopis! O giver of liberation! O O treasure of graceful pastimes! O Lord who enjoys pastimes in the forest! O lifter of Govardhana Hill! O source of all bliss!

s296.t: 1) O Śri Rādhā, O flag of sweetness, glory to You! O daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, glory to You!

s296.v:
(2)
lalitadi-sakhī-kumudavali-rake prema-mahamṛta-bhavita-rasamaya-
tanu-guṇa-rupa-kalape
nija-parijana-pariṣadi mam upanaya kalita-lalita-mamatake

s296.t: 2) O full moon that delight the lotus flowers that are Your friends headed by Lalitā! O Goddess whose sweet form, qualities, and beauty are flooded with the nectar of pure love, please accept me as one of Your associates.

s297.v:
(1)
nanda-suno kṛṣṇa govinda dṛśamayi diśi mayi nija-kṛpaya
maṁ jīvaya manda-smita-sudhaya

s297.t: 1) O son of Nanda, O Kṛṣṇa, O Govinda, please place Your glance of mercy on me. With the nectar of Your gentle smile please restor my life.

s297.v:
(2)
pīta-vasana mama kalaya mano nava-nīla-nalina-kamanīya-tano
ballava-nagara-vataṁsa vibho

s297.t: 2) O Lord splendid in yellow garments, O Lord whose form is graceful like an ever-new blue lotus flower, O crown of the gopas, O all-powerful one, please appear in my heart.
3) O dear Lord, please accept me.
